A.subject: Chemistry
A.text:
The products formed in the following reaction sequence are:

NO₂ on benzene ring
(i) Br₂, AcOH
(ii) Sn, HCl
(iii) NaNO₂, HCl, 273 K
(iv) C₂H₅OH
→ A + B
options: OH and Br on benzene ring (ortho/para arrangement)
OEt and Br on benzene ring with CH₂-COOH substituent
OH and Br on benzene ring with CH₂-CHO substituent
A.sol_text:
Solution:

Starting material: Nitrobenzene (NO₂ on benzene ring)

Step (i) Br₂, AcOH: Bromination occurs at the ortho and para positions (NO₂ is electron-withdrawing, a meta-directing group) relative to the NO₂ group, giving ortho/para-brominated nitrobenzene.

Step (ii) Sn, HCl: Reduction of the NO₂ group to NH₂ (amino group). The product is 3,5-dibromaniline (or ortho/para-brominated aniline).

Step (iii) NaNO₂, HCl, 273 K: Diazotization of the primary amine (NH₂) to form a diazonium salt (N≡N⁺ Cl⁻).

Step (iv) C₂H₅OH: The Sandmeyer-type reaction with ethanol reduces the diazonium group to H, replacing the diazonium with hydrogen. This is a deamination reaction.

The products are:
A = CH₂CHO (benzaldehyde derivative) - actually the diazonium intermediate gets reduced to form the C-H bond
B = Bromobenzene (benzene with Br substituent)

Final products: Bromobenzene with a CH₂CHO (aldehyde) side chain and Br-substituted benzene.

The correct answer is (3), which shows CH₂-CHO group on a Br-substituted benzene ring as one of the products.

B.subject: Chemistry
B.text: If 6.43 × 10⁵ coulombs of electricity are passed through an electrolytic cell containing NaClO₃, 245 g of NaClO₄ are produced at the anode at the end of electrolysis. The anode efficiency will be x%, then x will be (to the nearest integer)
B.sol_text:
Answer : 60
Hint:
Anode efficiency
= (Actual weight of any substance deposited)/(Theoretical weight deposited) × 100
= (Actual number of Faradays used up)/(Total number of faradays passed) × 100

Solution:
Anode reaction  ClO₃⁻ → ClO₄⁻

After balancing
ClO₃⁻ + H₂O → ClO₄⁻ + 2H⁺ + 2e⁻

2 F = 1 mol of NaClO₄
(245/122.5) mol of NaClO₄ = 2 × (245/122.5) = 4 F
So, for the production of 245 g of NaClO₄, 4 F of electricity i.e., 4 × 96500 C of charge is actually consumed. But we are given that a total of 6.43 × 10⁵ C of electricity is passed through the cell. So some of the charge is wasted
∴ Anode efficiency = (4×96500)/(6.43×10⁵) × 100 = 60%
B.nvt_note: Give your answer as the nearest integer.

A.subject: Mathematics
A.text: Let f : R → [0, 3] be a differentiable function such that (f(x))² f'(x) = 3(f(3x))² f'(3x) and lim(x→∞) f(x) = 2. Then, number of roots of the equation f(x) = cos x + 2x − (cos² x + x²) is
A.sol_text:
∫ f(x)² f'(x) dx = ∫ f(3x)² f'(3x) d(3x)

f(3x)³ = f(x)³ + c

f(x)³ − f(x/3)³ = c

f(x/3)³ − f(x/3³)³ = c

f(x/3²)³ − f(x/3³)³ = c

f(x/3ⁿ)³ − f(x/3ⁿ⁺¹)³ = c

Adding we get,

lim(n→∞) (f(x)³ − f(x/3ⁿ⁺¹)³) = (n+1)c

f(x)³ − f(0)³ = lim(n→∞) (n+1)c

As L.H.S. is bounded ⇒ c = 0 → f(x) = f(0)

∴ f is constant

∴ f(x) = 2

Now (x−1)² + (cos x − 1/2)² + 3/4 = 0

cos² x − cos x + 1 + x² − 2x + 1 = 0, no solution.

A.subject: Mathematics
A.text:
Let
R = {[x² y y²; y² x x²; 0 1 0] | x,y ∈ {0, 3, 5, 7, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19}}.

A matrix is randomly picked out of R, then the probability that the determinant of picked matrix is divisible by 5 is
A.sol_text:
Answer: (3)

Solution:
Let A be picked matrix
⇒ |A| = −(x⁴ − y⁴) = y⁴ − x⁴ = (x² + y²)(y − x)(x + y)

If 5 | |A| ⇒ (x, y) can be either picked from the set {3, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19} or {0, 5, 10, 15} then |A| will be divisible by 5.

⇒ Total matrices = 10² = 100

Favourable matrices = 6² + 4² = 52

⇒ P(5 | |A|) = 52/100 = 13/25

A.subject: Mathematics
A.text:
If vec(a)₁ = ai + bj, vec(a)₂ = vec(a)₁ - (2i + √5j) and vec(a)₃ = vec(a)₁ + (2i - √5j), then
|1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₁  1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₂  1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₃|
|1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₂  1 + vec(a)₂·vec(a)₂  1 + vec(a)₂·vec(a)₃| is equal to
|1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₃  1 + vec(a)₂·vec(a)₃  1 + vec(a)₃·vec(a)₃|
A.sol_text:
vec(a)₁ = (a, b), vec(a)₂ = (a - 2, b - √5), vec(a)₃ = (a + 2, b - √5)

Area of Δ whose vertices are vec(a)₁, vec(a)₂ and vec(a)₃ is

Δ = (1/2)|1  a  b|
        |1  a-2  b-√5|
        |1  a+2  b-√5|

⇒ Δ² = (1/4)|1  a  b| |1  a  b|
           |1  a-2  b-√5| |1  a-2  b-√5|
           |1  a+2  b-√5| |1  a+2  b-√5|

|vec(a)₁ - vec(a)₂| = 3, |vec(a)₁ - vec(a)₃| = 3, |vec(a)₂ - vec(a)₃| = 4

⇒ Δ = √5 × 2 × 2 × 1 = 2√5

Δ² = 4 × 5 = (1/4)|1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₁  1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₂  1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₃|
                 |1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₂  1 + vec(a)₂·vec(a)₂  1 + vec(a)₂·vec(a)₃|
                 |1 + vec(a)₁·vec(a)₃  1 + vec(a)₂·vec(a)₃  1 + vec(a)₃·vec(a)₃|

⇒ Required determinant = 4 × 20 = 80

B.text: For a twice differentiable function f(x), a function g(x) is defined as g(x) = (f(x))^2 + f(x)×f'(x) on [a, e]. If a < b < c < d < e and f(a) = 0, f(b) = 2, f(c) = -1, f(d) = 2, f(e) = 0, then the minimum number of roots of the equation g(x) = 0, is
B.sol_text:
∵ f(b)f(c) < 0
and f(c)f(d) < 0
⇒ f(x) = 0 has at least four roots,
a, c₁, c₂, e, where c₁ ∈ (b, c) and c₂ ∈ (c, d). Then, by RT, f(x) = 0 has at least three roots in, (a, c₁), (c₁, c₂), (c₂, e)
∴ f(x)f'(x) = 0 has at least 7 roots, by RT and hence,

g(x) = d/dx[f(x)f'(x)] = 0

has at least 6 roots.
B.nvt_note: Give your answer as the nearest integer.

B.subject: Mathematics
B.text: Given a₁ cosα₁ + a₂ cosα₂ + .... + aₙ cosαₙ = 0 and a₁ cos(α₁ + θ) + a₂ cos(α₂ + θ) + .... aₙ cos(αₙ + θ) = 0 (θ ≠ kπ), then the value of a₁ cos(α₁ + λ) + a₂ cos(α₂ + λ) + .... + aₙ cos(αₙ + λ) is
B.sol_text:
a₁ cos(α₁ + θ) + a₂ cos(α₂ + θ) + ... + aₙ cos(αₙ + θ) = 0
⇒ (a₁ cosα₁ + a₂ cosα₂ ... + aₙ cosαₙ) cosθ − (a₁ sinα₁ + a₂sinα₂ + ...... + aₙ sinαₙ) sinθ = 0
⇒ a₁ sinα₁ + a₂ sinα₂ + ... + aₙ sinαₙ = 0 (since sinθ ≠ 0) and a₁ cosα₁ + a₂ cosα₂ + .... + aₙ cosαₙ = 0
Now a₁ cos(α₁ + λ) + a₂ cos(α₂ + λ) + ..... + aₙ cos(αₙ + λ)
= (a₁ cosα₁ + a₂ cosα₂ + ... + aₙ cosαₙ) cosλ − (a₁sinα₁ + a₂sinα₂ + .... + aₙ sinαₙ) sinλ = 0
B.nvt_note: Give your answer as the nearest integer.
